Xin Xin notes Aug 6-8 Lake Baikal trough strength remains the key northward-deflection risk. Concentrating mass onto the Zhe-Min border bullseye: Wenzhou #1 (0.17 -> 0.23) and Ningde #2 (0.12 -> 0.20), holding Taizhou #3 (0.16) for modest northward shift, trimming Ningbo #4 (0.14 -> 0.11, mainland catch behind excluded Zhoushan islands), and adding Fuzhou #5 (0.08, replacing Shanghai 0.09) as the immediate southern flank (~60 km south of Ningde).
